## Line 141

```plato

    // A family's curve in a given phase at normalized time t.
    EaseAt(family: EasingFamily, phase: EasingPhase, t: Number): Number
        => match (phase) {
            In => EaseIn(family, t);
            Out => 1.0 - EaseIn(family, 1.0 - t);
            InOut => t < 0.5
                       ? EaseIn(family, 2.0 * t) / 2.0
                       : 1.0 - EaseIn(family, 2.0 - 2.0 * t) / 2.0;
        };
```
